limitations: This is a portal-discovery snapshot, not a complete cross-jurisdiction document inventory. It exists to reduce the work required of the first networked Bronze capture.

observations.capture_implication: enumerate rows; public links capture-target; QHEPS/login-required rows out-of-scope-public-v1
observations.denominator_status: table-visible; exact public-vs-login denominator to be computed by networked capture adapter
observations.observation: A large filterable table of guideline/attachment records is publicly enumerated; several rows point to QHEPS and explicitly require Queensland Health login.

observations.capture_implication: capture HSD and all public supporting records as distinct objects with parent/child lineage
observations.denominator_status: table-visible; networked adapter will compute exact row/object denominator
observations.observation: The current table exposes HSDs plus supporting guidelines, standards, protocols and registers, with all-HHS applicability recorded for the visible rows.

observations.capture_implication: create policy-framework parent plus 20 current mandatory-policy child targets; follow related standards/supporting documents
observations.observation: Clinical Governance, Safety and Quality currently lists 20 mandatory policy requirements under the framework.

observations.capture_implication: paginate the full result set, retain type/topic/date metadata, then capture each public linked artefact
observations.observation: The publication portal reports 213 results and exposes publication type/topic/clinical topic filters.

observations.capture_implication: crawl manual sections and linked current PDS records; retain policy number, document class, amendment/date and section lineage
observations.denominator_status: section-level living manual; exact current linked-document denominator to be computed by the networked Bronze adapter
observations.observation: The Patient Matters Manual is a living online consolidation of NSW Health policy directives, guidelines and information bulletins relating to patient care; legacy PDF chapter content has moved into the online manual.

observations.capture_implication: enumerate every domain and search route, then capture each policy/guideline as a distinct object with domain and mandatory/advisory class preserved
observations.observation: SA Health organises system-wide policies and guidelines into 20 Policy Domains and exposes A-Z, search and most-recent discovery routes; policies in each domain are mandatory.

observations.capture_implication: capture each linked record and classify document type/scope rather than treating every listed item as a policy
observations.observation: The ACT Health Directorate transparency page directly enumerates 100 linked policy-related records in the current page snapshot, spanning policies, procedures, guidelines, frameworks, strategies and plans.

observations.capture_implication: harvest public metadata and files, then apply document-class/scope filters while preserving repository identifiers and supplied checksums
observations.denominator_status: repository is broader than PPGs; policy/guideline/protocol denominator requires classifier plus metadata filtering
observations.observation: NT Health uses a distributed digital-library corpus containing typed publication records and controlled clinical documents, including guidelines/protocols with document-owner, approval, version and jurisdiction metadata.
